```{python}
from pqnii import pqnii

data_folder='data'

# Load single image
pqnii(
  f'{data_folder}/MNI152_T1_2mm_brain.nii.gz'
)

pqnii(
    image_path=f'{data_folder}/MNI152_T1_2mm_brain.nii.gz',
    overlay_path=f'{data_folder}/HO_2mm.nii.gz',
    width=400,
    height=400
)

```
